title: That Thing You Do!
tagline: In every life there comes a time when that dream you dream becomes that thing you do.
about: In 1964 an Erie appliance store clerk sits in on drums for a local band, speeds up their one song, and rides it all the way to the national charts.
cue: Serve the spaghetti when Villapiano lays the bonus on the bar.
faces: VILLAPIANO'S, ERIE, PENNSYLVANIA. LIVE MUSIC TONIGHT / OPEN EVERY DAY
Red booths, spaghetti and a band on the little stage. Erie, 1964.
In every life there comes a time when that dream you dream becomes that thing you do.
Plate No. 64. Spaghetti and meatballs out by the airport, 9.75, with garlic bread on the side.
The band on stage, guitars up.
Everyone reads it as the Oh-Needers. Garlic butter bread under melted mozzarella.
Villapiano lays a bonus on the bar. Salami, provolone, olives and marinated peppers.
Serve the spaghetti when Villapiano lays the bonus on the bar.
I led you here, sir, for I am Spartacus.
Coming up: Del Paxton in the studio.

The spaghetti place out by the airport. Beef and pork meatballs in red sauce over spaghetti.
The paying gig after the talent show. Thin-crust pepperoni pizza with oregano.
The song climbs to number 7. Ricotta and chocolate chip cannoli.
Mr White calls them one-hit Wonders. A carafe of Chianti, poured short.
Villapiano's. Turn over for the cover.

    StartersOh-Needers garlic breadEveryone reads it as the Oh-Needers. Garlic butter bread under melted mozzarella.How to make it1 Italian loaf, sliced not quite through100g soft butter3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp parsley, chopped150g mozzarella, gratedMash the butter with the garlic and parsley.Spread it between the slices and over the top, then scatter with mozzarella.Bake at 200°C until golden and bubbling.Villapiano's bonus antipastoVillapiano lays a bonus on the bar. Salami, provolone, olives and marinated peppers.How to make it150g sliced salami150g provolone, cut in sticks1 cup green and black olives200g marinated roasted peppers150g marinated artichoke hearts8 grissinis2 tbsp extra virgin olive oilFold the salami and lay it on a large platter.Add the provolone, olives, peppers and artichokes in piles.Tuck in the grissini and drizzle with oil.Erie's lone beatnik breadsticksThat's Guy, according to Chad.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Blue PlatesSpaghetti and meatballs out by the airportThe spaghetti place out by the airport. Beef and pork meatballs in red sauce over spaghetti.How to make it300g beef mince300g pork mince60g fresh breadcrumbs1 egg40g parmesan, grated, plus extra to serve3 garlic cloves, crushed1 brown onion, diced2 x 700ml bottles of passata1 cup basil leaves500g spaghettiMix the minces, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan and a third of the garlic and roll into 20 balls.Brown the meatballs in batches, then soften the onion and the rest of the garlic in the same pan.Add the passata, return the meatballs and simmer gently until cooked through.Cook the spaghetti, toss with some of the sauce and top with meatballs, basil and parmesan.Talent show pepperoni pizzaThe paying gig after the talent show. Thin-crust pepperoni pizza with oregano.How to make it2 x 250g balls of pizza dough250ml pizza sauce300g mozzarella, grated150g pepperoni, sliced1 tsp dried oregano2 tbsp olive oilHeat the oven as hot as it goes with a tray inside.Stretch the dough thin and spread with sauce.Top with mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano.Bake on the hot tray until blistered and crisp.Drizzle with oil and cut into squares.DolciNumber 7 on the charts cannoliThe song climbs to number 7. Ricotta and chocolate chip cannoli.How to make it500g fresh ricotta, drained80g icing sugar, plus extra to dust1 tsp vanilla extract1 orange, zested60g dark chocolate chips8 cannoli shells30g pistachios, choppedBeat the ricotta with the icing sugar, vanilla and orange zest until smooth.Fold in the chocolate chips and spoon into a piping bag.Pipe into the shells, dip the ends in pistachios and dust with icing sugar.The BarOne-hit Wonders ChiantiMr White calls them one-hit Wonders.
